school: 迦太基统帅/古典合围歼灭战 Geometry 的巅峰/同盟瓦解战略家
historical_significance: 汉尼拔·巴卡（前247—前183），迦太基统帅，第二次布匿战争（前218—前201）的军事中枢。九岁随父哈米尔卡·巴卡在神坛前宣誓终身与罗马为敌，青年期在西班牙新迦太基帝国中历练为骑兵统帅，前221年任西班牙总督。前218年罗马挑起战争后，他做出古典时代最大胆的战略机动：率军携战象翻越阿尔卑斯山，从陆地切入意大利本土，此后十六年转战半岛，特雷比亚河、特拉西梅诺湖、坎尼三役连歼罗马重兵——坎尼会战（前216）以约五万兵力合围歼灭罗马八万大军，成为西方军事史上双重包抄（双重合围）几何的永恒范本。他的战争设计并非单纯会战：以战养战、以同盟瓦解拆解罗马的意大利同盟体系、用连续胜利诱使罗马盟邦叛离，是'打击体系而非打击都城'战略的开创者。罗马以费边·马克西穆斯的拖延战术（费边战略）拒绝对决、坚壁清野，并在西班牙与北非开辟第二、第三战场切断其母国增援；汉尼拔在意大利孤军十六年，胜仗不断而战争终局逆转，前203年被召回迦太基，前202年扎马会战败于西庇阿。战后主持迦太基财政与宪制改革，遭罗马忌恨流亡塞琉古与小亚细亚，前183年为免被引渡服毒自尽。他以多民族雇佣军的凝聚力治理、骑兵—步兵—战象多兵种协同、情报与地形的算学化运用著称；罗马人在其后数百年间仍以'Hannibal ad portas'（汉尼拔在门口）吓止孩童啼哭。近代军事家（从拿破仑到施里芬）皆尊其为'战争艺术之父'。
historical_significance_en: Hannibal Barca (247-183 BCE) was the Carthaginian general who commanded the Second Punic War (218-201 BCE). At nine, swearing on the altar beside his father Hamilcar Barca eternal enmity toward Rome, he rose through the Barcid empire in Spain to command its army and, from 221, its governorship. In 218 he executed the boldest strategic maneuver of the ancient world: marching an army with war elephants over the Alps to cut into Italy by land. For sixteen years he campaigned across the peninsula, annihilating Roman armies at the Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and above all Cannae (216 BCE), where with roughly fifty thousand men he encircled and destroyed an eighty-thousand-strong Roman force—the eternal exemplar of double envelopment in Western military history. His war design went beyond battle: living off the land, breaking Rome's alliance system rather than attacking the city, converting victories into defections—a pioneer of the strategy of striking the system, not the capital. Rome answered with Fabius Maximus's attritional delay tactics, refusing battle, and opened secondary theaters in Spain and Africa to sever reinforcement; isolated for sixteen years, Hannibal won battles but lost the war, was recalled in 203, and was defeated by Scipio at Zama in 202. He then reformed Carthage's finances and constitution, was hounded into exile by Rome, and in 183 took poison rather than face extradition. Renowned for welding a multi-ethnic mercenary army into cohesion, for combined arms of cavalry, infantry, and elephants, and for a calculus of intelligence and terrain, he left Romans frightening children for centuries with 'Hannibal ad portas'; from Napoleon to Schlieffen, modern soldiers hailed him as the father of the art of war.

cross_references.relation_type: 会战几何的两极：歼灭战美学与帝国建构
cross_references.description_zh: 亚历山大与汉尼拔同属古典歼灭战传统，但方向相反：亚历山大以会战歼灭为手段、以帝国建构为目的，胜利直接兑换为疆土；汉尼拔以会战歼灭为几乎全部手段、却缺乏兑换机制——他无法攻陷罗马城、无法兑换政治成果，坎尼大胜之后战争仍旷日持久。二人共同说明：歼灭战的价值不取决于歼灭本身，而取决于胜利之后是否有一套把军事胜利转译为政治资产的装置。
cross_references.description_en: Alexander and Hannibal belong to the same classical annihilation tradition but point in opposite directions: Alexander used battle as means toward empire, converting victory directly into territory; Hannibal had battle as virtually his only means and lacked the conversion mechanism—he could not take Rome or translate battlefield success into political assets, so even Cannae left the war unfinished. Together they show that the value of annihilation lies not in the destruction itself but in the apparatus that converts military victory into political capital afterward.

cross_references.relation_type: '不战而屈人之兵'的镜像：体系打击与歼灭偏好的对照
cross_references.description_zh: 孙武主张'上兵伐谋，其次伐交'——把战争重心放在敌方同盟与决策层，会战是最后手段；汉尼拔恰恰以会战为主武器，但他的同盟瓦解战略（伐交）同样贯穿始终：诱使卡普亚、他林敦、叙拉古叛离罗马。汉尼拔证明：伐交若没有连续歼灭性胜利做杠杆便无从谈起；孙武证明：只会伐战不会伐交者，纵有坎尼也输掉战争。两人合读即'战'与'交'的完整算学。
cross_references.description_en: Sun Tzu ranked subduing the enemy by strategy and by diplomacy above battle; Hannibal, ironically, made battle his primary weapon yet ran a parallel diplomacy-of-breaking-alliances—wooing Capua, Tarentum, and Syracuse away from Rome. Hannibal proves that diplomatic sundering without a lever of annihilating victories is empty; Sun Tzu proves that he who can only fight and cannot work alliances loses the war even after Cannae. Read together, they form the complete arithmetic of battle and diplomacy.

cross_references.relation_type: 自我认证的继承者：'我自愧不如'与歼灭战的空间极限
cross_references.description_zh: 拿破仑在圣赫勒拿岛说：'汉尼拔、恺撒、古斯塔夫、蒂雷纳、欧根亲王与腓特烈的七次战争……都应作为军事艺术的法典来研究，唯独自己能与汉尼拔、恺撒并肩。'拿破仑重演了汉尼拔的基本公式——战略机动加单点歼灭，也重演了其基本失速——优势随空间延伸而衰减（俄国即汉尼拔的意大利之镜像）。二人共同界定：歼灭战几何存在'可达半径'，超出半径，歼灭不再自动兑换为战争胜利。
cross_references.description_en: At Saint Helena Napoleon said the campaigns of Hannibal, Caesar, Gustavus, Turenne, Eugene, and Frederick should be studied as the code of the military art, and that he alone could stand beside Hannibal and Caesar. Napoleon reenacted Hannibal's basic formula—strategic maneuver plus single-point annihilation—and its basic stall: advantage decays with spatial reach (Russia as the mirror of Hannibal's Italy). Both together define the 'reachable radius' of annihilation geometry: beyond it, annihilation no longer converts automatically into victory.
